papers.authors: McClure PW; Michener LA; Sennett BJ; Karduna AR
papers.measurement_method: Bone-fixed scapular electromagnetic sensor; humeral cuff sensor; thorax skin sensor

coordinate_conventions.description: Scapula relative to thorax; third Euler rotation about XS.
Scapula relative to thorax; Euler sequence external/internal rotation, upward/downward rotation, posterior/anterior tilt.
coordinate_conventions.proximal_coordinate_system: Thorax: ZT T7-to-T1; XT normal to T1-T7-SN plane; YT=ZT×XT
coordinate_conventions.distal_coordinate_system: Scapula: XS root of spine to AC; YS normal to AC-SP-IA plane; ZS=XS×YS
coordinate_conventions.reference_pose: Absolute anatomical orientation during standing arm elevation; starting arm at side
coordinate_conventions.supporting_source: McClure et al. 2001, pp. 270-272, Figure 2 and Figure 3B

coordinate_conventions.description: Clavicular elevation derived from tracked sternal notch and AC joint locations; clavicle not directly tracked.
coordinate_conventions.distal_coordinate_system: AC joint position tracked by scapular receiver
coordinate_conventions.unresolved_ambiguity: Derived clavicular angle, not a directly measured SC joint rotation.
